title: "WARNING: Be aware that there are nodes in the graph that share an exact name" in ROS 2: what breaks and how to rename, measured
excerpt: Two ROS 2 nodes with the same name: ros2 param get answered from either one, param set changed both, lifecycle and action calls reached both, topics kept working. Nine causes reproduced and four renaming fixes checked in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
